skill_name: Cloud Security, Cost Optimization & High Availability / DR
question_text: Write an ANSI SQL query to compute total spend and active resource count by cloud service for services >= $100 from `cloud_cost_usage_22`.
correct_answer:
SELECT service_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT resource_id) AS active_resources,
       SUM(cost_amount) AS total_spend
FROM cloud_cost_usage_22
GROUP BY service_name
HAVING SUM(cost_amount) >= 100.00
ORDER BY total_spend DESC;
answer_explanation: Aggregates cloud billing spend by service and filters out low-spend incidental line items.
reference_solution:

    cost_amount DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL,
    usage_date DATE NOT NULL
